summary.text: Jim Crawford is the Republican nominee for the Maryland House of Delegates, District 27A, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Darrell Odom (D).

Ballotpedia also lists him as a Republican candidate for Maryland House of Delegates District 28 in 2018, when he received 10.5% of the vote; the Maryland Manual's 2018 returns list James Crawford (R) of Charles County with 15,059 votes (10.5%) in District 28.
